editorial.blurb: The Oakville Grill & Cellar is a well-appointed American spot where the kitchen shines on standouts like French toast, dry-aged steak burgers, and tuna tartare, though consistency and service can vary.
editorial.insiderTip: Go for brunch or early dinner to secure a table when the room is less crowded; skip the cocktails and order the French toast, Costa Mesa salad with salmon, or dry-aged steak burger instead.
